sources.entry: MacUpdate Desktop - Simplifies finding, buying and installing apps for your Mac.

summary.name: MacUpdate
summary.one_liner: MacUpdate is a Mac software directory for finding, reading reviews of, and downloading apps for macOS, first launched in 1997.
use_cases: discover new apps for a Mac
compare and read reviews of Mac software
download free or paid Mac utilities
look up Mac antivirus or security suites
summary.what_it_does: The page is a listing directory of Mac software, showing recently updated apps with short descriptions and prices or a Free label. Entries include utilities such as fan control, text expansion, snippets management, desktop photo wallpapers, and several antivirus and security suites. The meta description says the site offers reviews of apps and describes itself as a complete Mac software directory. It is also described in the awesome-mac list as simplifying finding, buying and installing apps. The page text itself does not show details beyond these short listings.
notable: Recently updated listings with dates and prices
caveats: Many listed apps are paid, with prices such as $119.95 and $8.99
Listings are short and the page does not describe the site's own pricing
